analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc decomposition of seven external candidate stress outputs; no refitting or new experiment

decomposition_rule.identity: For every available point, residual_upper_bound = actual_absolute_residual + prediction_shift_upper_bound within numerical tolerance
decomposition_rule.zero_bound: If actual residual, shift and bound are all zero, retain an undefined share rather than assigning 0 percent
decomposition_rule.classification: prediction_shift_dominant when share >= 0.5; snapshot_residual_dominant when share < 0.5; undefined_zero_bound otherwise
decomposition_rule.gauss1_regression: Reproduce all four non-null same-point maxima from validation/gauss1-bound-mechanism.json

scope_rule.roszman1_increment: Add 25 total points, 5 available points, 20 unavailable points, 5 prediction-shift dominant points and 0 snapshot-residual dominant points
scope_rule.related_dataset_scope: Chwirut1 was not used in previous region design, but shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2; it is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test
scope_rule.periodic_candidate_scope: The ENSO candidate is not the native ENSO nine-parameter Fourier model; its 131 tighter ellipsoid/box pairs are a subset and not a probability or whole-dataset claim
scope_rule.roszman1_candidate_scope: The Roszman1 cubic/cubic candidate is not the native four-parameter arctangent model; its five available points occur only in fold 2, are not a 25-point probability coverage claim and are not an independent physical experiment
scope_rule.previous_comparison: Preserve exports/external-bound-decomposition.json and v2, v3, v4 versions and all their figures unchanged

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning or changing of frozen bounds
No conversion of unavailable points into zero bounds or zero shares
No probability, variance-decomposition or physical-mechanism interpretation of arithmetic shares
No universal ranking, native-periodic-model claim or erasure of Chwirut1/Chwirut2 relatedness
No native-arctangent-model, independent-physical-experiment or whole-Roszman1 coverage claim
